title: Shades of Mort'ton
start: Read a diary found in a house in Mort'ton.

items.t: 2 or more vial of water (can be obtained during quest)
2 or more ashes (can be obtained during quest)
2 or more clean tarromin (obtained during quest but this is a rather uncommon drop, so bringing extra tarromin is recommended.)
A pile of logs (can be gathered during quest)
1,000 or more coins to buy resources

recommended.t: Some druid pouches, to stop the Ghasts from rotting your food as you pass through the Mort Myre Swamp or the ouroboros pouch
An additional 13,000 coins will buy a flamtaer hammer, which speeds up the quest
5 or more additional clean tarromin (herbs obtained during quest are usually not enough)
A weapon to kill Loar Shades
Doing this quest in world 88 as it has many benefits and is dedicated to the Shades of Mort'ton minigame

rewards.t: A few hundred coins if the player uses Serum 208 on Razmire and Ulsquire
Ability to create Serum 207 and Serum 208
Ability to play the Shades of Mort'ton minigame, burn shades, and claim the rewards from the shade keys.
Players can take the diary of Herbi Flax to the Apothecary in Varrock who will exchange the book for 335 Herblore experience. This can only be done once.

steps.t: Enter the south-western ruined house in Mort'ton.

sub.t: Teleport to Canifis and run south-west to the gate of the swamp (must have Nature Spirit quest started), and then head to Mort'ton.
Teleport to fairy ring BKR and then run south by south-east to where the map says the Hollows, to find a rowboat that takes you there.
Alternatively use Drakan's medallion to teleport to the Barrows and run west.

steps.t: Search the shelf on the wall and read the diary. [Chat: Accept]

sub.t: If you do not find it, it's probably already in your bank.

p: The building where the quest is started.

steps.t: (Optional) Chop three swamp trees nearby and burn two logs to get the ashes.

sub.t: If you have an Underworld Grimoire equipped make sure to disable the auto-storage function, otherwise your ashes will be sent to the bank.

steps.t: (Optional) Pick up the vials (on the ground near the shelf) and search the smashed table for extra tarromin and one grimy rogue's purse.
Make vials of water by using the empty vials on the sink nearby.
Make Serum 207 by adding clean tarromin and ashes to a vial of water.
Use it on Razmire (afflicted) in the general store. [Chat: 4 What are all these shadowy creatures? › 1 Yes, I'll dispatch those dark and evil creatures.]
p: Killing a Loar Shade for Razmire.

steps.t: Kill five Loar Shades and pick up their remains. Be sure to talk to Razmire first. They can be safespotted using the rocks south west of the waypost in the middle of town.
Give him the remains. He may require more Serum 207.
Use the serum on Ulsquire Shauncy, located in the house east of the general store.
Wait a minute and ask him about the remains and the temple. [Chat: 1 What did you find out about the remains? › 2 What can you tell me about that temple? › 5 Ok, thanks.]
Talk to Razmire. [Chat: 3 I have another question. › 2 What can you tell me about that temple? › 4 Can you open a store for me? › 1 Can I see the general store please?]
Buy at least one olive oil from his general store and optionally a Flamtaer hammer.
Open his builders' store.
Buy 5 timber beams, 5 limestone bricks, 25 swamp paste.
p: Repairing the temple with other players on World 88.

steps.t: Hop to World 88 which is the official world for this minigame.
Head north-east and kill shades or repair the temple to increase your sanctity.
Repair the temple until you reach 100% and at least 20 sanctity.
Light the sacred altar in the centre of the temple.

For solo questers: Shade luring dummies can be used to distract the Loar Shades when repairing the temple. Using the Flamtaer bracelet, the solo player can instantly create the temple walls section by section, until at 100%.
Use your olive oil on the flame to make sacred oil.
(Optional) Use Serum 207 on the flame to make Serum 208, which permanently cures NPCs.
(Optional) Use the Serum 208 on Razmire and Ulsquire in the houses nearby to permanently cure them.
Use the sacred oil on a log to create a pyre log.
Head to south-western Mort'ton to the Funeral Fires (do not cross the river to the west). The Funeral Fires appear as black crosshairs on the minimap on the western part of the Mort'ton.
Use the Pyre Log to light the fire, then use the Loar Remains to sacrifice them on the funeral pyre.
Talk to Ulsquire.
Quest complete!
